name: vibe-visual-forge
description: Reference-driven UI prototypes, procedural GLB blockouts and structural/visual QA tools, with optional local MCP execution.

interface.longDescription: Design reference-driven responsive UI and create real procedural 3D blockouts with local MCP tools, screenshot checks and mesh audits. It does not bundle photoreal neural 3D generation, a GPU renderer or always-on cloud execution.
defaultPrompt: Create a production UI from my screenshots, render it and compare visual fidelity.
Create a game-ready 3D environment with materials, LOD and scene QA.
Inspect my project, find visual defects and fix them rather than showing a mockup.
